# Jubaer Tanjil Jami

> Jubaer Tanjil Jami, also known as Jubaer Jami, is a PhD student in Mechanical Engineering at the University of California, Merced, in the Martini Research Group.

His research uses molecular dynamics and multiscale computational methods to study how mechanical forces, including compression and shear, influence chemical reactions. Related topics are tribology, finite-element to molecular-dynamics coupling, machine-learned interatomic potentials, and high-performance computing.
